description: List TikTok videos that use a specific sound — caption, author, exact engagement, canonical hashtags, and mentions, with cursor pagination. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response. hasMore is true only when nextCursor is present.

limit.description: Most videos to return (default 20, 1–50; outside that range is a 400). TikTok serves this feed in short pages, so a call can return fewer than limit with a nextCursor to continue. Flat 2 credits per call.

url.description: TikTok music/sound URL, e.g. https://tiktok.com/music/name-ID. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: tiktok_music_posts
title: TikTok Music Posts
